serverInfo.name: @guardbee/mcp-dns-intelligence
serverInfo.description: MCP server that enumerates DNS records, detects misconfigurations, and identifies dangling subdomains

tools.name: enumerate_dns
tools.description: Enumerate all DNS records for a domain and detect SPF, DMARC, DKIM misconfigurations

tools.name: enumerate_subdomains
tools.description: Enumerate common subdomains for a domain and detect dangling subdomain takeover candidates

domain.description: Root domain to enumerate subdomains for (e.g. example.com)

tools.name: check_email_security
tools.description: Check SPF, DMARC, and DKIM configuration for a domain and get actionable remediation advice

domain.description: Domain to check email security for

dkimSelectors.description: Additional DKIM selectors to check (default: common selectors)

tools.name: lookup_dns
tools.description: Perform a targeted DNS lookup for specific record types on a domain

type.description: DNS record type to look up
